of or relating to or involving posture
examples: postural exercises

senses.definition: low blood pressure occurring in some people when they stand up
the arrangement of the body and its limbs
examples: he assumed an attitude of surrender

senses.definition: characteristic way of bearing one's body
examples: stood with good posture

senses.definition: a rationalized mental attitude
capability in terms of personnel and materiel that affect the capacity to fight a war
examples: we faced an army of great strength
politicians have neglected our military posture

senses.definition: behave affectedly or unnaturally in order to impress others
examples: Don't pay any attention to him — he is always posing to impress his peers!
She postured and made a total fool of herself

senses.definition: assume a posture as for artistic purposes
examples: We don't know the woman who posed for Leonardo so often

senses.definition: someone who behaves in a manner calculated to impress or mislead others
adopting a vain conceited posture
belonging to the period after a war
examples: postwar resettlement
postwar inflation

senses.definition: a woman who delivers the mail
an arrangement of flowers that is usually given as a present
